raw.details:
REGISTRATION PROCESS

Important: Participants must complete BOTH registration steps to participate in the hackathon.

Step 1: Register on Unstop

Complete your registration through the official Unstop event listing.

Step 2: Complete Hack2Skill Registration

After successfully registering on Unstop, participants must also complete their registration on Hack2Skill using the link below.

Hack2Skill Registration:
https://hack2skill.com/event/promptwars-x-noor-aith/registration

JOIN OUR OFFICIAL WHATSAPP COMMUNITY

Join our WhatsApp group to receive important announcements, updates, instructions, and event-related information.

https://chat.whatsapp.com/KSkf4oegNowGvxUuw0liu9?s=cl&p=a&iam=2

About the Hackathon

Welcome to PromptWars X AITH, a student-led innovation initiative designed to bring together creative minds, AI enthusiasts, developers, and problem-solvers.

This hackathon focuses on Artificial Intelligence, Prompt Engineering, creativity, and innovation. Participants will get an opportunity to showcase their skills, experiment with AI tools, collaborate with fellow innovators, and develop innovative solutions.

Event Highlights

  • AI and Prompt Engineering challenges.
  • Showcase your creativity and problem-solving skills.
  • Compete with talented innovators.
  • Opportunity to participate in an offline hackathon round at the college campus.
  • Learn, collaborate, build, and innovate.

Event Format

The initial participation and evaluation process will be conducted online. Shortlisted teams will be invited to the college campus for the final offline round.

Event Date

23 November 2026

Venue

Dr. AITD, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh

Organised By

AITD Events

Community & Initiative

PromptWars X AITH is an initiative aimed at encouraging students to explore the possibilities of AI-powered innovation, creative problem-solving, and practical application of emerging technologies.

Think. Prompt. Build. Win.

Don't just imagine the future. Build it with AI!
